note.en: A tiny limpet-like snail collected at 12 m off Cahuita in 2001. WoRMS treats the name as a synonym of Synaptocochlea montrouzieri, so the identity needs checking.
note.es: Un caracol diminuto tipo lapa recolectado a 12 m frente a Cahuita en 2001. WoRMS trata el nombre como sinónimo de Synaptocochlea montrouzieri, así que su identidad debe verificarse.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
